x.author: hispanicnomad
x.body:
Nah man, this is the end of SaaS

I needed to scan some documents, and didn’t feel like paying for a PDF creation tool

So I followed @levelsio advice…

And had Claude one shot me an web app that could take pictures of my documents, auto detect borders, improve legibility and export to PDF

Took it two prompts and less than 20 minutes

And it created a better app than any of the commercial ones I’ve used in the past

We’re truly living in the future!
